notes.title: Demo Patch Notes 0.3.5
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45100644/0c537fc0238a3229b1165f26001b9a92bea27e9b.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]New[/h2][list][*][p]Added flooring and wallpaper.[/p][/*][*][p]Placed treasure chests throughout various areas.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a copper axe upgrade.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]Reduced the overall amount of materials required for crafting items.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the number of items required for tool upgrades.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Other[/h2][list][*][p]Added a "Reset Game" button to the settings menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted some NPC friendship rewards.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes 0.3.4
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45100644/2a0e85947fe9e154a83099a9adbceb2d6225a4ef.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]New[/h2][list][*][p]Added controller support.[/p][/*][*][p]Added outfits.[/p][/*][*][p]Added rainy weather.[/p][/*][*][p]Added real-time reactions from guests.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Journal menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Skill menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a large boulder outside the inn.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a signpost at the crossroads.  [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]Improved sound effects when hitting and breaking rocks.[/p][/*][*][p]Guests now give gift rewards.[/p][/*][*][p]Added cursor size settings.[/p][/*][*][p]The game now automatically pauses when you click outside the game window.  [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where trees and rocks would reset their health when changing levels.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where fish would load slowly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various other bugs. [/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch notes 0.2.17
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45100644/62b1713313ccf1205fd73501f73e2ca065840f2f.png[/img]

[h2]New[/h2]
[list]
[*] You can now change key bindings from the menu.
[*] Added visual effects to the demo ending.
[/list]

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved the feel of fishing controls.
[*] Added a sound effect after finishing fishing.
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where some texts were displayed only in Korean.
[*] Lowered the volume of certain sound effects.
[*] Fixed an issue where actions would continue even after fainting.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch notes 0.2.13
notes.content:
[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Food now restores health.
[*] Taking a nap also restores health.
[*] Added eating sound effects.
[/list]


[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where Leo (the green NPC) leaves the inn in the early game, causing the player to get stuck inside.
Sorry, but if you encountered this bug in a previous version, please replace your save by following the link below.
[/list]
[url=https://www.notion.so/silestudio/How-to-replace-save-files-1a7c3b5406cf804fa512d1654a14a45c]How to replace save file[/url]
